style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Parables of the Lost
images.concept: He welcomes sinners and eats with them — the provocation that launches three stories about finding
images.imageAlt: A full table set for a meal with an extra cup placed informally among the others, as if a late guest has been included
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, overhead close view of a simple table surface with several clay cups and torn bread in casual arrangement, one additional cup placed slightly outside the formal grouping as if placed there for someone unexpected, the whole arrangement informal and welcoming, warm amber afternoon light across the table, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette, the extra cup the only element that speaks — the table that makes room, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Lost Sheep
images.concept: One left behind sought until found — the disproportionate joy over the one lost
images.imageAlt: A hillside of close-cropped dry grass with one patch of untouched longer grass in the far corner, unaccountably different
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a hillside of close-cropped dry pale grass extending across the frame, the whole surface uniform and flat, but in one corner of the image a small patch of longer ungrazed grass standing up unmowed and different, unreachable or overlooked, the difference in grass height the only event in the frame, warm raking afternoon light from the side, heavy film grain, muted dry gold and pale earth palette, the one different patch among the uniform — the one that matters, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: The Lost Coin
images.concept: Searching every corner with a lamp — the woman as God-figure, the found coin as occasion for heaven's joy
images.imageAlt: A small old coin catching lamplight in a dark corner of a stone floor, a lamp flame reflected in its face
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a dark stone floor with a small ancient coin lying in a corner where floor meets wall, the coin catching the warm light of a lamp nearby and reflecting a tiny bright point of amber in its tarnished face, the rest of the floor in deep shadow with only this small found brightness, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the dark stone, near-monochrome palette with only the reflected lamp warmth on the coin, the found thing illuminated in the dark — the search that ends here, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Prodigal Son's Return
images.concept: While he was still a long way off — the father running, the dead made alive
images.imageAlt: A long straight road across flat land converging at the horizon, a distant figure barely visible as a smudge, the near end empty
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a long straight dusty road stretching across flat open land to a pale horizon, the road empty and wide in the near foreground, at the very far end of the road at the horizon a barely perceptible dark smudge of a form, ambiguous and distant, morning backlight illuminating the dust of the road, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain especially in the sky, muted bleached palette of pale road and pale sky, the far figure on the long road — the return that changes everything, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: The Elder Son's Anger
images.concept: Outside the feast, unwilling to enter — obedience held as debt, joy refused at the door
images.imageAlt: Warm amber light and the sound of celebration implied by the lit windows of a house, the foreground outside in cool darkness
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, an exterior night view with the warm amber glow of lamplight visible through two small windows of a low stone building, the light inside suggesting warmth and activity, the ground outside the building in cool blue-gray darkness, a worn stone path leading from the darkness toward the lit doorway but the path empty and unused, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the outdoor darkness, muted palette of cool dark exterior and warm amber interior light, the outside refusing to come inside — the feast heard but not entered, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9
